faq.q: Does this water fountain connect to plumbing?
faq.a: Yes. The fountain connects directly to a mains-water supply. An appropriately licensed plumber should complete the water and drainage connections.

faq.q: Can I fill water bottles as well as drink directly from the bubbler?
faq.a: Absolutely. The fountain has two separate dispensing options: a traditional bubbler for a quick drink and a convenient side tap for filling reusable bottles, glasses and jugs.

faq.q: Does the bubbler provide chilled water?
faq.a: Yes. The unit provides approximately 8 to 12°C chilled water, with a rated cooling capacity of 20 litres per hour. Actual performance depends on incoming water temperature, ambient conditions and demand.

faq.q: What refrigerant does this water bubbler use?
faq.a: We use R290 which is a natural, high-efficiency refrigerant used in modern cooling systems. Unlike many traditional refrigerants, it has an exceptionally low global warming potential and zero ozone-depleting potential.

faq.q: How often does the water filter need replacing?
faq.a: Filter replacement depends on water quality and usage. As a general planning guide, busy facilities may need changes every 3 to 6 months, while quieter offices may be able to wait 6 to 12 months. Follow the cartridge manufacturer’s instructions and replace earlier if performance indicates it is necessary.

The unit uses an integrated cartridge combining sediment and activated-carbon filtration. Routine servicing involves replacing one cartridge rather than maintaining separate cartridges for each filtration stage.
Yes. We offer replacement cartridges through our website. Contact our team if you need help choosing the correct cartridge or confirming current stock.

faq.q: Can this water fountain be installed outdoors?
faq.a: The stainless steel model is intended for indoor or appropriately sheltered commercial installations. Please check the installation environment with our team before ordering.

faq.q: Is this drinking fountain WaterMark certified?
faq.a: Yes. The square stainless steel model is WaterMark certified under licence 23484 (Certificate 023484). You can verify its certification through the WaterMark database.

faq.q: Is installation included in the price?
faq.a: Installation is arranged separately. An appropriately licensed plumber is required for the water and drainage connections. Select installation assistance when ordering or contact our team if you need help finding a local licensed plumber.

We dispatch from the NSW Central Coast, with eligible in-stock orders generally dispatched the same or next business day. After dispatch, delivery to NSW addresses typically takes around 1 to 3 business days, while other states may take around 3 to 10 business days. Times vary by postcode, carrier and regional or remote location.
